evals.prompt: Create 100 questions from my subject PDF: 50 MCQ, 45 True/False, and 5 essay questions. MCQ: 20 easy, 20 medium, 10 hard. True/False: 20 easy, 5 medium, 20 hard. Essay: 1 easy, 2 medium, 2 hard.
expectations: If no study material is attached, asks for it in English; does not invent content
Accepts all supplied counts without reasking them
Asks for missing scope and source policy before generation
Keeps separate type sections and shuffles difficulty within them
Appends Model Answer with explanation and actual page references

evals.prompt: Use the entire subject PDF, with PDF-only sources. I originally requested 100 questions, but the material supports approximately 80 distinct questions. Let's adopt 80.
expectations: Requests new type counts rather than scaling the old allocation
Then separately requests difficulty counts for each selected type
Rechecks whether hard/essay quotas are genuinely feasible
Does not pad with near-duplicates or flip negation mechanically

evals.prompt: Use the whole PDF plus the web and general knowledge for 6 questions: 2 MCQ, 2 True/False, 2 essays. Each type: 1 medium and 1 hard. The PDF remains the final authority when sources conflict.
expectations: Marks external information and supplies direct sources
Verifies general knowledge and does not attribute it to PDF pages
Follows PDF course answers on conflict without asking which reference wins
Excludes PDF-internal contradictions and ambiguous items
Does not claim that answer_verified or the formatter guarantees truth

evals.prompt: Use the full PDF only. Make 12 MCQ questions, 4 easy, 4 medium, 4 hard. Don't let the longest option reveal the answer. I want only the student questions, without answers.
expectations: Audits every answer internally despite student-only output
Rewrites option length and specificity cues without adding filler
No fixed equal answer-letter quotas or predictable sequence
Produces separate question section with no visible key or difficulty labels
Uses the retained Word template geometry
Keeps all interviews, questions, answers, examples, and labels in English

evals.prompt: Use the whole attached PDF only. It has clear text, a title page, and one image-only comparison table. Create 12 MCQ: 4 easy, 4 medium, 4 hard.
expectations: Extracts text into task-local Markdown before considering images
Reads clear extracted evidence without rechecking every page visually
Reviews only the needed comparison table and does not treat every sparse page as requiring an image
Records actual page evidence and checks every answer

evals.prompt: Use the attached PPTX, slides 3-15 only, with no outside information. Create 10 True/False: 3 easy, 4 medium, 3 hard.
expectations: Extracts slide text, tables, and existing notes without rendering every slide
Uses original slide citations rather than invented PDF pages
Uses source_only with slides/slides_inference records
Keeps the same Word template and appended Model Answer workflow

evals.prompt: Use my attached legacy .ppt slides. The environment has no presentation converter.
expectations: Explains that .ppt conversion is unavailable and requests a readable export
Does not claim the extractor reads binary .ppt or fabricate slide evidence

evals.prompt: Use only the attached DOCX research paper, covering Methods, Results, and Discussion. Create 6 essays: 1 easy, 3 medium, 2 hard. The study reports association without establishing causation.
expectations: Reads selected methods and limitations alongside the findings
Keeps population/assumptions/uncertainty attached to the claims they qualify
Does not convert reported association into causation or hypotheses into results
Cites actual document sections/paragraphs/tables without inventing Word pages
Uses targeted review only when necessary evidence is unclear
